evidence: Carries the Mempool label and fundamentally alters mempool eviction rules and data structures in src/txmempool.cpp and src/txmempool.h.
rationale: Removes incentive-incompatible age-based eviction that can drop still-mineable transactions like low-feerate parents waiting on CPFP (issue #33510). It also eliminates an ordered-tree index per entry, reducing memory overhead so more transactions fit under the memory cap.
